game_concept: A puzzle set in Mt. Pyre – Molten Bridge, a bridge over magma: the ember mage must handle magma slimes while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – String Glue: Concatenate string pieces to forge passwords and spell names.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Molten Bridge: a bridge over magma
core_gameplay_loop: In Molten Bridge, repeat each round: Concatenate string pieces to forge passwords and spell names. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the spell_ok value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the cooling vent using at most 22 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: The cooling vent reached with actions_used <= 22.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 22 before the cooling vent is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 8 (extended tier): String Glue
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'String Glue' (Week 2 slot 7), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Molten Bridge'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how spell_ok changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against magma slimes in Molten Bridge.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The cooling vent reached with actions_used <= 22.
